data.name: AlreadyRunning
data.value: RetailCore is already open. Return to the existing window.

data.name: SetupHelp
data.value: Create your shop and first owner. Keep the owner PIN safe.

data.name: ComingSoon
data.value: This section will be available in a later milestone.

data.name: SetupDone
data.value: Shop created. Sign in with your owner PIN.

data.name: ApprovalHelp
data.value: An owner must confirm these exact shop settings with their PIN. Approval expires in two minutes.

data.name: InvalidCredentials
data.value: Incorrect user or PIN. Try again.

data.name: AccountLocked
data.value: This account is locked for 15 minutes after repeated incorrect PINs. Wait or ask an owner to reset it.

data.name: SignInRequired
data.value: Please sign in again to continue.

data.name: OwnerRequired
data.value: Only an active owner can perform this action.

data.name: ApprovalRequired
data.value: Owner approval is missing, expired or no longer matches. Review and approve again.

data.name: InvalidPin
data.value: Enter a PIN containing 6 to 12 digits (0–9).

data.name: PinMismatch
data.value: The two PIN entries do not match.

data.name: InvalidUser
data.value: Enter a name of up to 100 characters and select owner or cashier.

data.name: InvalidProfile
data.value: Check required names, text lengths, paper width (40–300 mm) and cash increment (1–100000 minor units).

data.name: InvalidTimeZone
data.value: Enter a valid time zone, for example Asia/Colombo.

data.name: CurrencyFixed
data.value: The existing shop currency cannot be changed.

data.name: LastOwner
data.value: Keep at least one active owner account.

data.name: DuplicateUser
data.value: That display name is already in use. Choose another.

data.name: AlreadyConfigured
data.value: This shop has already been configured. Sign in instead.

data.name: LocalConfiguration
data.value: This database must contain one active shop and one active terminal. Ask for support before continuing.

data.name: OwnerMissing
data.value: No active owner was found. Ask for support to recover access; do not create a replacement database.

data.name: OperationConflict
data.value: This request identifier was already used for another operation. Refresh and try again.

data.name: StorageError
data.value: The data could not be opened or saved. Check available disk space and file access, then retry. Keep the existing database.

data.name: UnexpectedError
data.value: The action could not finish. Try again or ask for support.

data.name: ProductSearch
data.value: Search name, SKU, barcode or category

data.name: InvalidNumber
data.value: Enter a valid number using the current language format.

data.name: InvalidProduct
data.value: Enter SKU, both names, Sinhala receipt name, barcode, category, valid unit, nonnegative cost and positive price.

data.name: InvalidCategory
data.value: Enter Sinhala and English category names and select a valid category.

data.name: InvalidPricing
data.value: Use up to three ascending positive quantity breaks with positive prices that never increase. Whole-item units need whole thresholds.

data.name: InvalidQuantity
data.value: Enter a positive quantity with up to three decimals; whole-item units require whole quantities.

data.name: DuplicateSku
data.value: This SKU is already used, including inactive products. Choose another SKU.

data.name: DuplicateBarcode
data.value: This barcode is already used, including inactive products. Choose another barcode.

data.name: CatalogueHelp
data.value: Select a row to edit or preview. Click a column heading to sort. Clear Active to deactivate; save to confirm. Prices use the shop currency. Blank breaks are unused. Stock comes from the signed ledger.

data.name: StockHelp
data.value: Select a product to see its shared base-stock balance and full history. Receive in selling units; costs are per entered unit. Counts use base units. Configure packs before their first movement. Changes need an owner; adjustments/counts require PIN approval.

data.name: StockConfiguration
data.value: Base product, pack conversion and reorder threshold

data.name: AllowNegativeStock
data.value: Request owner approval to allow negative stock

data.name: ConsumptionHelp
data.value: Consumption preview only: selected product plus a sealed pack; no sale or stock movement is saved.

data.name: InvalidStockQuantity
data.value: Enter a valid nonnegative count or positive movement, with at most three decimals. Whole-item units require whole quantities. Check cost precision too.

data.name: StockPrecision
data.value: This conversion is finer than 0.001 base units. Use a compatible quantity or pack factor.

data.name: InvalidStockConfiguration
data.value: Choose an active base product with no parent. Only Pack products can link to another base. Use a positive exact conversion; each/pack base units need whole factors. Set reorder on the base product.

data.name: StockMappingLocked
data.value: Stock history or linked packs already use this mapping. Keep the unit/conversion, or create a new product.

data.name: StaleStockCount
data.value: Stock changed since the preview. Refresh and review the new balance before approval.

data.name: OpeningAlreadyRecorded
data.value: This base product already has stock history. Use receiving or an approved adjustment instead.

data.name: InsufficientStock
data.value: Insufficient stock. A reason and explicit owner approval are required to go negative.

data.name: InvalidStockEntry
data.value: Enter a reason, valid date no later than today, quantity and cost. Check the movement type.

data.name: StockPostingConflict
data.value: This source was already posted with different stock details. No additional stock was written.

data.name: BillingKeyboardHelp
data.value: Scan a barcode and press Enter. Repeated scans add quantities. F2: scan, Ctrl+F: search, F4: cash, F6: remove, F9: complete. Manual weights allow three decimals.

data.name: RequestedFinalPrice
data.value: Proposed final unit price (blank = automatic tier)

data.name: ManualPriceHelp
data.value: A proposed final unit price replaces the quantity tier; it does not stack a discount. It must be positive and no higher than the qualified tier price. Owner PIN approval is required at settlement. Clear this field to return to automatic pricing.

data.name: ExternalCardApproved
data.value: Payment was approved on the external card terminal

data.name: CardReferenceHelp
data.value: Enter only a short external approval identifier, e.g. AUTH-4471, or leave blank. Never enter a card number, PIN or security code. This app does not charge the card.

data.name: VerifyLastCompletion
data.value: Verify last saved bill (no new payment)

data.name: ScanInProgress
data.value: Scans are still processing. Wait for the basket, then retry.

data.name: InvalidFloat
data.value: Enter a nonnegative opening float with valid currency precision.

data.name: ShiftAlreadyOpen
data.value: A shift is already open on this terminal. Refresh Billing to use it.

data.name: OpenShiftRequired
data.value: Open a shift with the counted opening float before completing a sale.

data.name: BarcodeNotFound
data.value: No active product uses that barcode. Check the code or search by name/SKU.

data.name: AmbiguousBarcode
data.value: More than one legacy product uses this barcode. Ask the owner to correct the catalogue.

data.name: InvalidBillingQuantity
data.value: Enter a positive quantity with at most three decimal places. Each/Pack need whole quantities.

data.name: InvalidManualPrice
data.value: Enter a positive final unit price no higher than the current tier and a reason. Clear the proposed price if a quantity change qualifies for a better tier.

data.name: BillingProductUnavailable
data.value: A basket product is inactive, incomplete or invalid. Remove it or ask the owner to correct Products.

data.name: BillingTaxUnavailable
data.value: A product has no effective tax rule for today. Ask the owner to correct its tax assignment.

data.name: BasketEmpty
data.value: Add at least one item before settlement.

data.name: CheckoutChanged
data.value: Prices, tax, shift or stock changed since review. Refresh Billing and review the new total before paying.

data.name: InsufficientTender
data.value: Cash received is less than the rounded amount due. Enter the full tender.

data.name: CardApprovalRequired
data.value: Confirm approval on the external card terminal before recording the payment.

data.name: InvalidTender
data.value: Enter a valid cash tender or record the exact externally approved card amount.

data.name: InvalidCardReference
data.value: Use only a short alphanumeric external approval reference, or leave it blank. Card numbers, PINs and security codes are not accepted.

data.name: StaleBasket
data.value: The saved basket changed or was completed. Refresh Billing to recover its current state and last result.

data.name: BasketTooLarge
data.value: A basket supports up to 200 different products. Complete or clear this basket first.

data.name: BillingAmountTooLarge
data.value: The basket amount is too large. Reduce the quantity or ask the owner to correct its price.
